instructions.humanOwned: Fill only semantics properties. Null, empty arrays, and empty objects are intentional blanks.
instructions.compilerOwned: The compiler refreshes mechanics and database metadata and preserves semantics during synchronization.
instructions.authority: The database is authoritative for mechanics. This file is the sole authority for human meaning.

semantics.purpose: Store user-entered end-of-day balances used to reconcile the derived ledger.
semantics.rowMeaning: One account's known balance at the end of one calendar date.
importantRules: The known balance is expressed in the account currency's smallest native units.
There is at most one assertion per account and balance date.
semantics.sensitivity: Contains private financial structure or metadata; expose only within the authenticated user's session.

semantics.sensitivity: Private accounting data belonging to the authenticated user.

semantics.meaning: Person whose ledger owns this balance assertion.

semantics.purpose: Store the user-defined accounts that receive double-entry line items.
semantics.rowMeaning: One account belonging to one person's ledger.
importantRules: Every account has an explicitly chosen type and currency.
New users begin with no accounts; there is no implied root account or base currency.
Only posted transaction line items contribute to displayed balances.

semantics.purpose: Store the signed account postings that make up double-entry transactions.
semantics.rowMeaning: One signed posting to one account within one transaction.
importantRules: amount_units is a signed integer in the referenced account's currency.
Every transaction requires at least two line items.
The application centrally validates that transaction values sum exactly to zero in the valuation currency.

semantics.purpose: Store double-entry accounting transaction headers and lifecycle state.
semantics.rowMeaning: One dated accounting event composed of two or more signed line items.
importantRules: Posted transactions must balance exactly to zero in valuation_currency_id.
A transaction and all accounts it uses must belong to the same person.
Draft, posted, and voided are explicit states; posted is never inferred from dates.

semantics.purpose: Store exact rational exchange rates for multi-currency transactions and optional reference rates.
semantics.rowMeaning: One exact ratio converting positive source units to positive target units.
importantRules: Transaction rates use positive integer ratios rather than floating-point decimals.
Each foreign account currency used by a transaction needs exactly one rate into its valuation currency.
Reference rates never determine posted accounting values unless explicitly copied into a transaction rate.
semantics.sensitivity: Contains private financial structure or metadata; expose only within the authenticated user's session.
